faq.a1: There is a free plan with no time limit. The Pro plan includes one free month, no credit card required. Current prices are on the Pricing page.
faq.q2: Does it work without an internet connection?
faq.a2: Yes. The mobile app works offline: your clients, products and invoices stay available, and everything syncs automatically once you're back online.
faq.a3: Yes, along with EUR, USD, MAD and other currencies. Local VAT (Cameroon, Senegal, Ivory Coast…) is applied automatically.
faq.a4: Your data is encrypted, backed up, and remains yours. You can export it at any time.
faq.a5: No. You create invoices and purchase orders as usual; the accounting entries are generated automatically in the background.
